recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17644; future ISO 3166-2 terminology content or tx support package work should be handled in the maintained terminology source/package pipeline.
issue_request: FHIR-17644 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue requesting terminology server support for urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2, with the Jira comment saying the content was generated into fhir.tx.support.
initial_application: Historical commit 716c103a9c91af2f011cc9937e4f519933dd5bca ('generate iso 3166-2') added CountryCodesConverter.java and generated CodeSystem metadata for urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2 into fhir.tx.support package output paths. The converter and package-generation source are no longer present as current core build artifacts.
additional_context: FHIR-17644 followed FHIR-15869, which added ISO 3166-2 subdivisions to the Jurisdiction value set and is already represented on the combined branch. Current core source still lists urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2 on the Code Systems page and uses it in datatype examples, while THO publishes an active ISO3166Part2 CodeSystem and includes the URI in the Jurisdiction ValueSet. Later FHIR-31537 was rejected as no-change because the value set expanded in the current build.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The seed asked for terminology server support data, and current evidence shows that support exists in maintained terminology publication/package infrastructure; restoring or editing the removed historical converter in core would not be a correct current-spec fix.

related_jiras.note: Underlying STU3 Jurisdiction value set change added ISO 3166-2 subdivisions; it is already audited on the combined branch and was not re-decided here.
Later Resolved - No Change Vocab issue about unknown urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2 concluded the value set expands in the current build.
